blocks.value: The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) is India's oldest stock exchange and one of the oldest in the world.
Imagine This: Think of an old, respected university that has educated students for more than 100 years. The BSE has a similarly rich history in India's financial markets.
The BSE was established in 1875. Today, thousands of companies are listed on it and millions of trades happen every day.
The SENSEX is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange.
Most major companies are listed on both NSE and BSE.
